text:
maria-partners: Hey team — we need to finalize the partner SEV escalation paths for marketplace, hardware vendors, and SI integrations before next week's joint announcement. Proposal: create a shared read-only channel per partner + a 1-page war-room template for SEV1s. Anyone object?

ajay-sre: Sounds good. Quick Q — what's our auto-escalation threshold? 10m to oncall for latency SEV1?

maria-partners: leaning 10m for infra/backplane issues, 30m for degraded-but-functional. We can make thresholds per partner in the template.

toni-sales: Also need CSM + partner legal in the notify list. Marketing wants a single press hold contact for embargoed announcements.

kevin-partnerops: putting a first-pass contact matrix below — plz review and correct.

kevin-partnerops: ```
Partner: NimbusCloud
Primary CSM: nina@nimbus.com
Escalation: oncall-sre@redwood.com -> ajay-sre
War room: https://war.room/nimbuscloud
Shared channel: #partners-nimbuscloud (read-only for partner)
---
Partner: TitanHW
Primary CSM: alan@titanhw.com
Escalation: partner-ops@titanhw.com -> kevin-partnerops
War room: https://war.room/titanhw
Shared channel: #partners-titanhw
```

partner-bot: :robot_face: war-room created: https://war.room/1738001234 (auto-link)

lina-engineering: Add a short runbook snippet to the template. e.g. `Triage -> Mitigate (fallback routing/replica) -> Escalate -> Postmortem`. Suggest including a simple circuit-breaker play for model-serving degredation.

ajay-sre: For shared channels: make them read-only for partners, with a pinned folder for incident artifacts and an `#war-room-archive` tag for compliance. Also add an `oncall-ack` step so we know someone has the pager.

maria-partners: +1 on read-only and `oncall-ack`. Toni — can you confirm who will be the press hold contact for Nimbus & Titan?

toni-sales: Confirmed: Nimbus -> me (toni-sales), Titan -> partner-ops (kevin-partnerops). I'll loop legal.

maria-partners: Action items: 1) kevin -> publish contact matrix to shared drive and create channels (due EOD Thu). 2) lina -> draft 1-page war-room template + runbook snippet (due Wed). 3) ajay -> add oncall-ack step and thresholds to SRE playbook (due Wed). 4) toni -> confirm press contacts & legal loop (due Tue). I'll schedule a 30m dry-run next Fri. :white_check_mark:

kevin-partnerops: On it. I'll also add a short how-to for partners on channel etiquette and permitted artifacts.

maria-partners: Thanks all. If anyone wants to join the dry-run, ping me. I’ll post the calendar invite. :calendar:
